why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open pantherdao.app , the app linked from Panther's X profile, and read the legal notice before you tick it.
Connect a wallet and pick the network: Polygon or Base for now.
Complete onboarding and pass KYC with the compliance provider the app sends you to. It checks your ID and runs sanctions screening, and the fee is paid in ZKP.
Activate your Panther account. Keep a little POL or ETH for gas; the first activation is subsidised. Claim the onboarding PRP under Rewards.

Deposit an approved token in the zAssets tab. Holding builds pending PRP; sending, swapping or withdrawing makes it available. Warning You are putting real money into a pool that has been drained before. Deposit only what you can afford to lose, and never enter a seed phrase on any site.
Redeem available PRP for ZKP in the Rewards tab. Check the rate shown before you confirm, because it moves.
